¿Cómo se usa la conservación de la energ: How is conservation of mechanical energy used?
Sin rozamiento, ½mv² + mgh + ½kx² se man: Without friction, ½mv² + mgh + ½kx² stays constant. A ball falling 5 m from rest reaches v = √(2gh) = √(2 · 9.8 · 5) ≈ 9.9 m/s. With friction, the final energy is the initial energy minus the work done by the friction force.
¿Cómo se calcula el trabajo de una fuerz: How is the work done by a force calculated?
W = F·d·cos θ, y el trabajo total es igu: W = F·d·cos θ, and the total work equals the change in kinetic energy. A 10 N force dragging an object 3 m at an angle of 60° does W = 10 · 3 · 0.5 = 15 J.

Rozamiento en la rampa y en el llano: Friction on the ramp and on the flat
En la rampa la normal es $N = m g cos θ$: On the ramp the normal force is $N = m g cos θ$, and the distance travelled is $L = h/{sin θ}$, so $W_fr = −{μ m g h}/{tan θ}$. On the horizontal section $N = m g$. The work done by friction becomes heat: the grey bar in the animation.
Un muelle comprimido una distancia x gua: A spring compressed a distance x stores $E_s = 1/2 k x^2$. If there is also friction under the spring, the maximum compression comes from $1/2 m v_C^2 = 1/2 k x^2 + μ m g x$. Afterwards the spring pushes the block back if its force $k x$ exceeds the static friction.
En lo alto de un rizo de radio R el peso: At the top of a loop of radius R the weight and the normal force point to the centre: $m g + N = m v^2/R$. Since N cannot be negative, we need $v^2 ≥ g R$ at the top, and without friction this requires starting from $h ≥ 5R/2$. If it does not make it, it leaves the track where N becomes zero and falls like a projectile. A pendulum is the same with the tension of the string instead of the normal force: $T = m (v^2/L + g cos θ)$.

Si la fuerza cambia con la posición, el: If the force changes with position, the work is the area under the graph F(x): $W = ∫ F dx$. If it is the only force doing work, $W = ΔE_k$. Power is work per unit time: average $P_{avg} = W/t$ and instantaneous $P = F v$.
